entries.title: Google Sheets request quota may be exhausted
entries.cause: Google documents per-minute request quotas. A Sheets 429 is consistent with a quota limit, but this catalogue cannot inspect the affected Google project or establish the exact cause.
entries.recommendation: Inspect the original response and quota use locally. For confirmed time-based quota failures, reduce request frequency and use bounded exponential backoff with jitter. Inspect the outcome before replaying writes.
manualTest: In a separate authorized test workflow, make one read after the quota window has refilled. Do not generate traffic to force a quota failure.
Check the Google project's quota usage and original response locally. Compare the observed error with the time-based quota explanation in Google's documentation.
For writes, inspect the destination before retrying so a previously completed write is not duplicated.
rollback: Save the current workflow configuration before any manual change.
If a scheduling or retry change causes unwanted delays, restore that configuration and keep the original workflow paused until its writes have been checked.
limitations: No live Google request, customer workflow or repair has been tested.
This is documentation-backed troubleshooting guidance, not a confirmed root cause or an automatic retry.

entries.title: Model output may not satisfy the configured schema
entries.cause: The selected error class indicates a possible mismatch between generated output and a configured JSON Schema. This service receives no schema or model output and cannot confirm the mismatch.
entries.recommendation: Inspect the schema and the model output locally. Check required fields and field types. n8n's generated-from-example schema treats every field as mandatory, and its Structured Output Parser does not support $ref.
manualTest: Copy the workflow into an authorized test environment and use a synthetic model response with the expected field names and types.
Check that the synthetic response satisfies the parser's configured schema; then review one failing output locally without sending it to this service.
If using Generate from JSON Example, check whether making every example field mandatory matches the intended contract.
rollback: Export or save the existing prompt and parser configuration before changing them.
Restore the previous prompt and parser configuration if the change alters downstream data contracts; do not remove validation merely to hide an error.
limitations: No model generation, user schema, customer execution or repair has been tested.
The error class is a local classification hint; it is not proof of a root cause.
